'''Gene-code sequencer locks''' were a type of [[Lock/Legends|locking mechanism]]. The [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had doors that were secured by gene-code sequence locks. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] infiltrators used an [[OutlawTech]] [[Lock Breaker]] in an attempt to break into the Palace until they were stopped by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].<ref name="EGWT" />
